Logic, memory and coding games for kids

Thinking skills grow with practice. In Memory cards children find matching pairs, in Pattern finder they spot the rule and choose what comes next, in Odd one out they work out which item does not belong, and in Code Brainy they plan a path of arrows to reach the star. Each game starts gently and gets trickier as your child levels up.

Get started →

🛡️ No ads · No chat with strangers · Parents in control

What your child learns

  • Working memory and concentration
  • Recognising patterns and sequences
  • Sorting and reasoning
  • Planning steps in order, the basis of coding
  • Persistence: trying again until it works

Questions parents ask

What are the benefits of logic games for children?

Logic games train memory, attention and reasoning, skills children use in maths, reading and everyday problem solving. Short, regular sessions work best.

Is the coding game suitable for beginners?

Yes. Code Brainy needs no reading and no experience: children choose arrows to move Brainy step by step, then press Go to see if their plan works.
